summary: Circumstantial evidence case; no eyewitness; independent witnesses testified to signing blank papers under police pressure; investigating officer failed to properly investigate; High Court erred by convicting sole appellant while acquitting six co-accused; standard for circumstantial evidence: complete chain pointing unerringly to guilt required; inconsistent testimonies and procedural violations rendered conviction unsustainable.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction set aside; appellant acquitted.
